FREELANCE SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Freelance Services Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of January 1, 2025, by and between MegaCorp Inc. ("Client") and Jane Doe ("Contractor").

1. Scope of Work

Contractor shall perform web development services as described in the attached Statement of Work. Any work beyond the stated scope shall require Client's verbal approval. Contractor is expected to accommodate reasonable scope adjustments without additional charges.

2. Payment Terms

Client shall pay Contractor a flat fee of $5,000 upon project completion. Invoices are due within ninety (90) days of submission. No late fees shall apply. Client may withhold payment if, in Client's sole judgment, the deliverables are unsatisfactory.

3. Intellectual Property

All work product, including preliminary drafts, notes, and concepts, shall be the exclusive property of Client from the moment of creation. Contractor assigns all rights, including moral rights, to Client. Contractor shall not retain any copies or use any work product for portfolio purposes without Client's prior written consent.

4. Confidentiality

Contractor agrees to hold all Client information in strict confidence indefinitely. This obligation has no expiration. Contractor shall not disclose any information about the engagement, including the existence of this Agreement, to any third party without Client's prior written consent. Client has no reciprocal confidentiality obligations.

5. Indemnification

Contractor shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Client and its officers, directors, employees, and agents from and against any and all claims, losses, damages, liabilities, and expenses (including attorneys' fees) arising from or related to Contractor's services, regardless of fault. Client shall have no indemnification obligations to Contractor under any circumstances.

6. Limitation of Liability

Client's total liability to Contractor under this Agreement shall not exceed $500, regardless of the nature of the claim. Contractor's liability to Client shall be unlimited. Client shall not be liable for any lost profits, business interruption, or consequential damages suffered by Contractor.

7. Termination

Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, for any reason, with immediate effect upon written notice. Contractor may not terminate this Agreement without Client's consent. Upon termination by Client, Contractor shall deliver all work completed to date. Client shall have no obligation to pay for partially completed work.

8. Non-Compete

Contractor agrees not to perform similar services for any of Client's competitors for a period of twenty-four (24) months following termination of this Agreement. This restriction applies nationwide.

9. Dispute Resolution

Any disputes arising under this Agreement shall be resolved exclusively by binding arbitration in Client's home jurisdiction. Contractor waives any right to a jury trial. Each party shall bear its own costs, but Contractor shall reimburse Client's legal fees if Client prevails.

10. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to conflict of laws principles. Contractor consents to exclusive jurisdiction in the courts of Delaware for any actions not subject to arbitration.

11. Force Majeure

Force majeure events shall excuse Client's performance obligations but shall not excuse Contractor's obligations. Contractor must continue to perform regardless of force majeure conditions or face termination for cause.

12. Warranties

Contractor warrants that all work product will be free from defects for a period of five (5) years following delivery. Contractor warrants that deliverables will meet all of Client's expectations, whether stated or unstated. Client makes no warranties of any kind.

13. Amendments

This Agreement may be amended by Client at any time upon written notice to Contractor. Contractor's continued performance after receipt of any amendment shall constitute acceptance.

14. Assignment

Client may assign this Agreement to any party without Contractor's consent. Contractor may not assign any rights or obligations under this Agreement.

15. Notice

All notices to Contractor shall be sent by email to the address on file. All notices to Client shall be sent by certified mail to Client's registered office. Notices to Contractor are deemed received immediately upon sending; notices to Client are deemed received five (5) business days after mailing.
